_provenance: SYNTHETIC replay for the demo dataset, generated by scripts/seed-demo.ts from scripts/fixtures/manifest.ts on 2026-11-14. No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was available in the build environment, so these outputs were authored to match the dataset's ground truth instead of recorded from the live API. They exercise the pipeline end to end; they do not measure model accuracy. Re-record with `RECORD=1 DEMO_REPLAY=0 npm run replay:record` and run `npm run test:accuracy` (§13).

courses.title: Rye, roe & dill
courses.description: A thin crisp of dark rye, whipped smoked-trout crème fraîche, rainbow trout roe and dill flowers — two bites that nod to the rye bread stolen on the first date.
courses.story_for_menu_card: Half of his rye bread, finally returned.

dietary_variants.change: Rye crisp with smoked beetroot tartare, oat crème fraîche and dill.

courses.seasonality_note: June brings the first dill and new-season trout roe.

courses.title: First-date salmon soup, clarified
courses.description: A clear salmon and trout broth poured at the table over cold-smoked trout, potato pearls, leek ash and dill oil; finished with a spoon of cream on the side, as at Löyly.
courses.story_for_menu_card: The soup she ordered at Löyly on our very first date.

dietary_variants.change: Smoked carrot and kombu broth with charred leek, potato pearls and dill oil.

courses.seasonality_note: New potatoes and early-summer leeks are at their sweetest.

courses.title: Three nights in Naples
courses.description: Chicken thigh braised in a Starita-style marinara of datterini tomatoes, garlic and oregano, with pecorino polenta, wood-roasted courgette and crisp fried-dough 'angioletti'.
courses.story_for_menu_card: Margherita, marinara and one last pizza on the street.

dietary_variants.change: Braised giant beans and roasted aubergine in the same marinara, with olive-oil polenta.

courses.seasonality_note: Early datterini and courgettes arrive in June.

courses.title: Mökki blueberries
courses.description: Wild blueberry granita over vanilla buttermilk mousse with a pistachio and rye crumb.
courses.story_for_menu_card: Berries picked at the cottage that morning.
courses.seasonality_note: Bilberries are still early in June; use last summer's frozen wild berries.

courses.title: Proposal-night Eton mess, reimagined
courses.description: Scottish strawberries macerated in elderflower, crisp vanilla meringue shards, Chantilly cream and a strawberry-rhubarb sorbet, built at the table in a cut-glass coupe.
courses.story_for_menu_card: The pudding we shared at the Sheep Heid on the night she said yes.

dietary_variants.change: Aquafaba meringue, whipped oat cream and the same strawberries and sorbet.

courses.seasonality_note: Peak strawberry season in Scotland and Finland alike.
